description: Search Amber's Slime Studio's handmade slimes by words (name, scent, colour, charms), texture and maximum price. Returns pots with price in GBP, stock, texture, scent, image and product URL, best matches first. Call with no arguments to list everything on sale.

in_stock_only.description: When true (default) only slimes that can be ordered now: in stock, or open for pre-order

limit.description: How many results to return, 1 to 20 (default 10)

max_price_gbp.description: Highest price per pot in pounds, e.g. 9.5

query.description: Words to match against names, scents, textures, colours and charms, e.g. 'unicorn', 'cherry', 'pink butter'. Omit to browse everything.

texture.description: Texture slug or name from list_textures, e.g. 'butter-slime', 'cloud', 'icee', 'thick-and-glossy-slime'

name: search_catalog

original_price_gbp.description: Pre-sale price in GBP when the slime is on sale, else null

preorder_allowed.description: True if it can be ordered while out of stock

price_gbp.description: Price per 250ml pot in pounds sterling (GBP), e.g. 8.99

price_pence.description: Price per pot in pence (GBP minor units), e.g. 899

slug.description: Product slug; use it with get_product, check_promo and create_basket_link

texture_slug.description: Texture slug, as used by list_textures and the texture filter

total.description: Matches before the limit was applied

title: Search slimes
